name: dock-bay
title: DockBay
summary: Grid of dock-bay cards. Each bay shows: bay number (mono), state (open / occupied / reserved / out-of-service), optional carrier + ETA. Color-coded by state via PILL tokens. Click to drill into bay detail.
description: Grid of dock-bay cards with state-coded chrome.
skillDescription: Use to visualize cross-dock floor occupancy. State-coded: open=success, occupied=neutral, reserved=info, out=danger. Pass `bays={[]}` to render; consumer wires onClick for drill-in. For top-down pallet-cell view inside an occupied bay use @lumen/cross-dock-grid.
never: NEVER mix occupied + open + reserved without distinct colors.
NEVER fake an ETA (omit if unknown — don't show 'TBD' as a number).
a11yRules: Each bay card is a <button> with aria-label='Bay {number}, {state}{', carrier ' + carrier}{', ETA ' + eta}'.
do: Use 5-7 cols on desktop; 2-3 on mobile.
